title: Head of Human Capital Management Solution Advisory Japan at Leading Software Company Believes SmartHR Should Prioritize AI Integration Over Complex Payroll Expansion
expert: Former Head of HCM Solution Advisory Japan at a leading global software company; 20 years in Japan HCM
verdict: A former Japan HCM advisory head sees Oracle losing very-large-enterprise (>10,000 employees) labor-management customers 'little by little' to local and modern SaaS vendors, with no churn rate given.

Competition & share: 🔴 **Oracle losing >10,000-employee labor-management customers "little by little"** in Japan (no rate); conflicts with a UBS partner relay that Dell consolidated on Fusion and cut SAP, Salesforce and Workday (SB #67339, U.S.). → Tenet 5 (apps & database) ↓
🟡 **SAP SuccessFactors 25–30% of Japan HR cloud revenue** (estimate); SAP and Talent Palette top two in talent management, Workday catching up; first read.
Demand / orders: 🟡 **Japan large-enterprise labor-management SaaS penetration 70% vs 80–90% for talent management** (estimate); first read.

changes: Fusion HCM competitive position: Oracle losing Japanese very-large-enterprise labor-management customers vs UBS partner relay that Dell consolidated on Fusion, cutting SAP, Salesforce and Workday (SB #67339, 2026-11-04): **conflicting** (different geography, single-partner relays on both sides).
First read on Japan HCM cloud penetration; no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: Tenet 5 (apps & database profit engine): ↓ slight — gradual Japan HCM churn at the largest enterprises; no rate or revenue given and Japan HCM is a small part of apps.
